records.title: Differential Mamba
records.reason: Primary abstract: Sequence models like Transformers and RNNs often overallocate attention to irrelevant context, leading to noisy intermediate representations.

records.title: Scaling Context Requires Rethinking Attention
records.reason: Primary abstract: We argue that neither transformers nor sub-quadratic architectures are well suited to training at long sequence lengths: the cost of processing the context is too expensive in the former, too inexpensive in the latter.

records.title: EA-DETR: Edge-Aware Detection Transformer for Water Surface Floating Object Identification
records.reason: Primary abstract: Designed to address the challenge of identifying water surface floating objects with transparent features under complex backgrounds such as irritating light sources, we introduce Edge-Aware Detection Transformer(EA-DETR), a novel end-to-end object detection model based on DINO-ResNet50.

records.title: MOST: Memory Oversubscription-Aware Scheduling for Tensor Migration on GPU Unified Storage
records.reason: Primary abstract: Deep Neural Network (DNN) training demands large memory capacities that exceed the limits of current GPU onboard memory.
